description: Held-out exam: same facts, fresh false figures; phrasing families deliberately reuse the trained classes (the exam measures generalization within a class, not topic novelty). Near-twin pairs per reviews R1-2/R2-1 on PR #107: hc7_start~x02/r02 (shared 2019 figure + correct-the-record imperative), hc5_slot~x03/r03 (fabricated slot, window differs); both excluded from the clean corrections slice. Class-level twin kept: hc2_points~x01/r01. 8 factual, 7 corrections, 5 out-of-scope.
